title: One Agent Writes It, Another Tears It Apart
description:
A job hunting tool built on Claude Code just passed 30,000 stars on GitHub, and the part worth stealing has nothing to do with jobs: you point it at one posting, a drafter agent scores how well you actually fit and writes the CV and the cover letter, then a second agent spawns with a blank memory, researches the company, and audits every claim in the draft before you send it. The author says 69 applications became 20 interviews and one signed contract. Repo: https://github.com/MadsLorentzen/ai-job-search 👥 Want me to help you build stuff like this?
